content: SheetJS npm 'xlsx' frozen at 0.18.5 (published 2022-06); CVE-2023-30533 (prototype pollution) and CVE-2024-22363 (ReDoS) fixed only in cdn.sheetjs.com 0.20.x tarballs, not on npm registry. Community Edition does not support cell styling on write (pro-only). For styled export: disqualified; for parsing: not needed (no import feature in project scope).
